summary.text: Kyle McNorton is a Republican state representative who has represented Kansas House District 50 since his appointment in October 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A former University of Kansas and Kansas City Chiefs football player, he also serves on the Seaman School District board and is vice chair of the House Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: McNorton was born in Topeka, Kansas, earned a high school diploma from Seaman High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Kansas in 1985.
His career experience includes working in business management, for petroleum supplier Capital City Oil in Topeka, and playing football for the Kansas Jayhawks and the Kansas City Chiefs.

McNorton was appointed to the Kansas House to replace Representative Fred Patton and assumed office on October 24, 2023; he is also a member of the Seaman School District board, with a term ending in 2030.
During the 2025-2026 session he served on the House Federal and State Affairs and K-12 Education Budget committees and as vice chair of the House Education Committee.
